section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: 10 Table 8 presents statistics of suicidal deaths by different means adopted for self-destruction. A majority of persons adopted drowning, hanging and poisoning as principal means of destroying their lives. These three means were responsible for about 25·3%, 18·8% and 16·9% of total suicidal deaths respectively. TABLE 8
